title: Why SoftBank’s new $40B loan points to a 2026 OpenAI IPO
description: Wall Street giants JPMorgan and Goldman Sachs are extending a 12-month, unsecured loan to the Japanese conglomerate.
author: Marina Temkin

title: Memory chip giant SK hynix could help end ‘RAMmageddon’ with blockbuster US IPO
description: SK hynix’s potential U.S. listing could raise $10-$14 billion to help it build more capacity, encourage others to follow, and end the 'RAMmageddon' memory shortage.
author: Kate Park

title: VCs are betting billions on AI’s next wave, so why is OpenAI killing Sora?
description: When an 82-year-old Kentucky woman was offered $26 million from an AI company that wanted to build a data center on her land, she said no. Sure, that same company can try to rezone 2,000 acres nearby anyway, but as AI infrastructure stretches further into the real world, the real world is starting to push back.  That tension is everywhere […]
author: Theresa Loconsolo, Anthony Ha, Kirsten Korosec, Sean O'Kane

title: OpenAI shuts down Sora while Meta gets shut out in court
description: When an 82-year-old Kentucky woman was offered $26 million from an AI company that wanted to build a data center on her land, she said no. Sure, that same company can try to rezone 2,000 acres nearby anyway, but as AI infrastructure stretches further into the real world, the real world is starting to push back.  That tension is everywhere […]
author: Theresa Loconsolo

title: David Sacks is done as AI czar — here’s what he’s doing instead
description: Sacks will be much further from the power center in Washington than since the outset of this second Trump administration.
author: Connie Loizos

title: Anthropic wins injunction against Trump administration over Defense Department saga
description: A federal judge has ordered that the Trump administration rescind recent restrictions it placed on the AI company.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: You can now transfer your chats and personal information from other chatbots directly into Gemini
description: Google is launching "switching tools" that, just as it sounds, will make it easier for users of other chatbots to switch to Gemini.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Wikipedia cracks down on the use of AI in article writing
description: The site, whose policies are subject to change, has struggled with the issue of AI-generated writing.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: OpenAI abandons yet another side quest: ChatGPT’s erotic mode
description: It's only the latest of several side projects that the AI startup has ditched over the past week.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Data centers get ready — the Senate wants to see your power bills
description: Senators Josh Hawley and Elizabeth Warren want the Energy Information Administration to gather more details about how data centers use power — and how that affects the grid.
author: Tim De Chant

title: ByteDance’s new AI video generation model, Dreamina Seedance 2.0, comes to CapCut
description: The new model in CapCut will have built-in protections for making video from real faces or unauthorized intellectual property.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Conntour raises $7M from General Catalyst, YC to build an AI search engine for security video systems
description: Conntour uses AI models to let security teams query camera feeds using natural language to find any object, person, or situation.
author: Ram Iyer

title: Cohere launches an open-source voice model specifically for transcription
description: Relatively light at just 2 billion parameters, the model is meant for use with consumer-grade GPUs for those who want to self-host it. It currently supports 14 languages.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: A ‘pound of flesh’ from data centers: one senator’s answer to AI job losses
description: Fears of AI-driven job loss are growing fast, and they’re fueling backlash against data centers. Sen. Mark Warner suggests taxing them to help workers survive the transition.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Mistral releases a new open-source model for speech generation
description: Mistral's new speech model can run on a smartwatch or a smartphone.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: The least surprising chapter of the Manus story is what’s happening right now
description: Did anyone think there would not be a reckoning over this tie-up?
author: Connie Loizos

title: Mercor competitor Deccan AI raises $25M, sources experts from India
description: Deccan AI concentrates its workforce in India to manage quality in a fast-growing but fragmented AI training market.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: The AI skills gap is here, says AI company, and power users are pulling ahead
description: Anthropic finds AI isn’t replacing jobs yet, but early data shows growing inequality as experienced users gain an edge, raising concerns about future displacement and workforce divides.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Google unveils TurboQuant, a lossless AI memory compression algorithm — and yes, the internet is calling it ‘Pied Piper’
description: Google’s TurboQuant has the internet joking about Pied Piper from HBO's "Silicon Valley." The compression algorithm promises to shrink AI’s “working memory” by up to 6x, but it’s still just a lab experiment for now.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Melania Trump wants a robot to homeschool your child
description: The first lady sees AI and robotics playing a prominent role in the future of American education.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Bernie Sanders and AOC propose a ban on data center construction
description: Senator Bernie Sanders and Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez introduced companion legislation to halt construction on new data centers until Congress passes comprehensive AI regulation.
author: Tim Fernholz

title: Google launches Lyria 3 Pro music generation model
description: Google is launching Lyria 3 Pro, an upgraded music model that generates longer, more customizable tracks, as it expands AI music tools across Gemini, enterprise products, and other services.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Reddit takes on the bots with new ‘human verification’ requirements for fishy behavior
description: Reddit will require suspected automated accounts to verify they’re human, as it ramps up efforts to curb bot-driven spam and manipulation.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Harvey confirms $11B valuation: Sequoia triples down
description: Investors like Sequoia, Andreessen Horowitz,  Kleiner Perkins, and Elad Gil can't get enough of AI legal tech startup Harvey.
author: Julie Bort

title: Granola raises $125M, hits $1.5B valuation as it expands from meeting notetaker to enterprise AI app
description: Granola's valuation jumped from $250 million to $1.5 billion with this round, and it has added more support for AI agents after users previously complained.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Meta launches new initiative to support entrepreneurship, drive AI adoption
description: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg said in a memo to staff that small businesses have always been a big part of the company's business model, and that while tens of millions of entrepreneurs already use its platforms to grow and connect with customers, the company wants to do more in the space.
author: Aisha Malik

title: Meta turns to AI to make shopping easier on Instagram and Facebook
description: Meta is using generative AI to provide more product and brand information to consumers when they're shopping in its apps.
author: Sarah Perez

title: With Sift Stack, two ex-SpaceX engineers are bringing the software that helped launch rockets to the factory floor
description: Sift is building the data infrastructure for advanced manufacturing.
author: Tim Fernholz

title: Lucid Bots raises $20M to keep up with demand for its window-washing drones
description: Lucid Bots has seen demand accelerate over the last year for its window cleaning drones and power washing robots.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: With $3.5B in fresh capital, Kleiner Perkins is going all in on AI
description: The fundraise includes $1 billion for investing in early-stage startups, and $2.5 billion for late-stage growth businesses.
author: Marina Temkin
